name: Breathing Pattern
description: Tracks periodic chest and shoulder micro-movements at physiological breathing frequencies, leveraging the FakeCatcher framework to expose deepfakes that fail to replicate natural respiratory rhythms.
mechanism:
This method detects deepfakes by analyzing breathing patterns as biological signals following Ciftci et al. (2020):

1. **Chest/Shoulder Motion Extraction**: Periodic chest expansion and shoulder elevation associated with respiration are tracked via body landmark detection. The respiratory motion signal is extracted by measuring vertical displacement of shoulder landmarks and chest region optical flow, compensating for other body movements.

2. **Respiratory Rate Estimation**: The respiratory signal's power spectrum is analyzed to extract breathing frequency. Normal resting respiratory rate is 12-20 breaths/minute (0.2-0.33 Hz). The method checks: (a) presence of a clear respiratory spectral peak, (b) rate within physiological range, (c) consistency across the recording.

3. **Breathing Regularity Analysis**: Natural breathing exhibits characteristic variability — respiratory rate varies with cognitive load, speech, and autonomic regulation. The coefficient of variation of inter-breath intervals follows expected distributions. AI-generated video may show either absent breathing motion or artificially regular breathing without natural variability.

4. **Cardio-Respiratory Coupling**: In authentic subjects, breathing and heart rate show physiological coupling (respiratory sinus arrhythmia — heart rate increases during inspiration). The method checks cross-correlation between extracted respiratory and cardiac (rPPG) signals. Deepfakes lack this physiological coupling, as neither signal is generated from real biological processes.

5. **Speech-Breathing Coordination**: During speech in video, breathing patterns synchronize with linguistic phrasing — speakers inhale at phrase boundaries. The method verifies that detected inspiration events align with speech pause patterns. AI-generated videos typically fail to produce coordinated speech-breathing dynamics, serving as a forensic indicator.
parameters:
Analysis type: sensor
Media: video
Input: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Output: Confidence score (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderate to High — 70-88% standalone accuracy. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated video through breathing pattern analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for video authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard video formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other video forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by video compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic video

references.title: Ciftci, U.A. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
Qi, H. et al. (2020). DeepRhythm: Exposing DeepFakes with Attentional Visual Heartbeat Rhythms. ACM MM.
